title.en: EVE Academy – Mining and Resource Acquisition
title.zh: EVE 学院：采矿与资源采集

blocks.en: Almost everything you interact with in EVE was built by players,
blocks.zh: 你在 EVE 中接触到的几乎一切都是玩家制造的，

blocks.en: from ships, modules and ammunition
blocks.zh: 从舰船、装备和弹药，

blocks.en: to massive player-owned structures and supercapital ships.
blocks.zh: 到大型玩家建筑和超级旗舰。

blocks.en: Everything that players build is assembled from resources gathered
blocks.zh: 玩家制造的一切，都由

blocks.en: through various activities from across the galaxy.
blocks.zh: 通过各种活动从银河各处采集的资源组装而成。

blocks.en: Whether it's mined from asteroids, pulled from the surface of a planet,
blocks.zh: 无论是从小行星上开采、从行星表面提取、

blocks.en: ripped from the face of a moon or harvested from interstellar
blocks.zh: 从卫星表面剥离，还是从星际间的

blocks.en: clouds of gas and ice.
blocks.zh: 气云和冰矿中采集。

blocks.en: If you are ever curious about the components used to build something,
blocks.zh: 如果你好奇某样东西是用什么部件制造的，

blocks.en: or what a resource can be used to create,
blocks.zh: 或者某种资源能用来制造什么，

blocks.en: you can right-click on that item, show info
blocks.zh: 可以右键点击该物品，选择「显示信息」，

blocks.en: and then click on the Industry tab.
blocks.zh: 然后点击「工业（Industry）」标签页。

blocks.en: This will show you the blueprint required to create it,
blocks.zh: 这里会显示制造它所需的蓝图、

blocks.en: the resources you can get from reprocessing it,
blocks.zh: 提炼它能获得的资源，

blocks.en: and even what that item can be used to build, if applicable.
blocks.zh: 以及该物品可以用来制造什么（如果有的话）。

blocks.en: To see the full bill of materials used to create that item,
blocks.zh: 要查看制造该物品所需的完整材料清单，

blocks.en: click show info on the blueprint from this window
blocks.zh: 在此窗口中对蓝图点击「显示信息」，

blocks.en: and expand the "Required input materials" drop down.
blocks.zh: 展开「所需材料（Required input materials）」下拉菜单。

blocks.en: You can use blueprints such as this to build items, which we will cover
blocks.zh: 你可以用这样的蓝图来制造物品，我们会在

blocks.en: in more detail in the Basic Industrial Production video.
blocks.zh: 《工业生产基础》视频中详细介绍。

blocks.en: Manufacturing Resources fall into a few basic categories
blocks.zh: 制造资源分为几个基本类别，

blocks.en: which cover most of the items players build in-game.
blocks.zh: 涵盖了玩家在游戏中制造的大部分物品。

blocks.en: Basic Ore is mined from asteroids,
blocks.zh: 基础矿石从小行星上开采，

blocks.en: and is a primary component in most ships and items built in New Eden.
blocks.zh: 是新伊甸中大多数舰船和物品的主要原料。

blocks.en: Moon materials are gathered via moon mining,
blocks.zh: 卫星原料通过卫星采矿获得，

blocks.en: which requires a large refinery structure
blocks.zh: 这需要一座大型精炼厂建筑

blocks.en: to blast off a chunk of the moon to be mined.
blocks.zh: 把卫星炸下一大块来开采。

blocks.en: Gas can be harvested from gas clouds and is used in advanced ship production.
blocks.zh: 气云可以从气云区域采集，用于先进舰船的生产。

blocks.en: Ice materials can be obtained from mining in ice belts and are used primarily
blocks.zh: 冰矿原料可以在冰矿带中开采，主要用于

blocks.en: to make fuel blocks which power large structures.
blocks.zh: 制造为大型建筑供能的燃料块。

blocks.en: Planetary commodities are obtained through planetary industry
blocks.zh: 行星商品通过行星开发获得，

blocks.en: and are used in a wide range of goods depending on what you choose to build.
blocks.zh: 根据你要制造的东西，可用于各种各样的产品。

blocks.en: Salvage can be gathered from the wrecks of ships or from exploring hidden Relic Sites
blocks.zh: 打捞材料可以从舰船残骸中获得，也可以通过探索隐藏的遗迹站点获得，

blocks.en: and is used in the production of ship rigs, which are in constant demand.
blocks.zh: 用于生产需求经久不衰的舰船改装件。

blocks.en: And lastly, abyssal materials which are gathered from running,
blocks.zh: 最后是深渊材料，通过刷深渊、

blocks.en: looting and surviving in abyssal deadspace.
blocks.zh: 在深渊中搜刮战利品并活下来获得。

blocks.en: We'll be discussing many of these items in more detail in later videos.
blocks.zh: 我们会在后续视频中详细讨论其中许多物品。

blocks.en: If you're just starting out in EVE,
blocks.zh: 如果你刚开始玩 EVE，

blocks.en: it can be helpful to pick one type of resource to master before moving on to others.
blocks.zh: 先精通一种资源再去尝试其他资源会很有帮助。

blocks.en: Many industrialists will focus on harvesting a single resource
blocks.zh: 许多工业玩家会专注于采集单一资源，

blocks.en: and sell what they don't use.
blocks.zh: 把自己用不上的卖掉。

blocks.en: They can then use the profits to buy the remaining components
blocks.zh: 然后用赚来的钱购买其余部件，

blocks.en: that they need to build the ships or modules
blocks.zh: 用来制造他们

blocks.en: they've set their hearts on creating.
blocks.zh: 一心想要打造的舰船或装备。

blocks.en: In the Trading for Profit video, we'll cover market trading in more depth,
blocks.zh: 在《交易赚钱》视频中，我们会更深入地介绍市场交易，

blocks.en: but for now, head out mining to make a bit of profit
blocks.zh: 但现在，先去采矿赚点钱，

blocks.en: and start working your way up to building your first items.
blocks.zh: 一步步迈向制造你的第一批物品。

blocks.en: Equip a pair of mining lasers to a venture and head out!
blocks.zh: 给冲锋者级装上两个采矿激光器，出发吧！

blocks.en: You can find nearby asteroid belts and ore anomalies
blocks.zh: 打开代理机构窗口，选择「资源采集（Resource Harvesting）」标签页，

blocks.en: by opening the Agency window and selecting the 'Resource Harvesting' tab.
blocks.zh: 就能找到附近的小行星带和矿石异常。

blocks.en: Then select the resource you're looking for.
blocks.zh: 然后选择你要找的资源。

blocks.en: For now, we're going to choose "Ore Anomalies",
blocks.zh: 这次我们选择「矿石异常（Ore Anomalies）」，

blocks.en: as these often contain rarer ores than may be found in belts.
blocks.zh: 因为这里往往有比小行星带更稀有的矿石。

blocks.en: On the next screen, you can now see a list of nearby systems which contain Ore anomalies.
blocks.zh: 在下一个界面中，你可以看到附近有矿石异常的星系列表。

blocks.en: Pick one and click the "Set Destination" button
blocks.zh: 选一个，点击代理机构界面右下角的

blocks.en: in the lower right-hand corner of the Agency screen.
blocks.zh: 「设为目的地」按钮。

blocks.en: Then undock and make your way to that system.
blocks.zh: 然后离站，前往那个星系。

blocks.en: Upon arrival, you'll need to open your ship's probe scanner window
blocks.zh: 到达后，你需要打开舰船的探针扫描窗口

blocks.en: to locate the Ore Anomaly you are looking for.
blocks.zh: 找到你要去的矿石异常。

blocks.en: Click the 'Scanners' button to the lower left side of your capacitor
blocks.zh: 点击电容左下方的「扫描器」按钮，

blocks.en: and then select the Probe Scanner.
blocks.zh: 然后选择探针扫描器。

blocks.en: This will open the system map and the probe scanner window.
blocks.zh: 这会打开星系地图和探针扫描窗口。

blocks.en: In the Probe Scanner window, locate the Ore Anomaly,
blocks.zh: 在探针扫描窗口中找到矿石异常，

blocks.en: right click on it and choose 'warp to'.
blocks.zh: 右键点击它，选择「跃迁至（Warp To）」。

blocks.en: Unlike cosmic signatures, these types of anomalies do not need to be scanned
blocks.zh: 与宇宙信号不同，这类异常无需扫描

blocks.en: before you can warp to them.
blocks.zh: 就能直接跃迁过去。

blocks.en: Once you arrive, switch to your 'mining' overview tab, lock up some asteroids
blocks.zh: 到达后，切换到总览的「采矿」标签页，锁定几颗小行星，

blocks.en: and activate your mining lasers.
blocks.zh: 启动采矿激光器。

blocks.en: Go out, gather materials to your heart's content
blocks.zh: 出发吧，尽情采集资源，

blocks.en: and you will start amassing wealth in no time.
blocks.zh: 你很快就会开始积累财富。
